title: 権限・除外チェック時と実アクセス時でsymlink解決が食い違い、承認済みに見えるパス経由で保護対象ファイルへ到達する
summary: Two providers fixed the same mechanism in the same week. Claude Code v2.1.253 (early Sept 2026): 'Fixed file tools following symlinks swapped after permission check, risking unauthorized access' — a time-of-check/time-of-use gap where a path is approved, then the symlink is swapped so the file tool operates on a different target. Gemini CLI v0.58.0 (2026-09-01): 'Enforced consistent symlink evaluation in ignore path handling to prevent path bypass' — ignore/exclusion paths evaluated inconsistently against symlinks allowed bypassing protections. Codex CLI 0.151.0 (2026-08-29) similarly 'Improved remote sandbox enforcement using the executor's actual home directory', a path-resolution mismatch between policy and executor. Mechanism: permission/ignore decisions are made on a lexical or check-time path while the filesystem operation resolves symlinks at use time, so protected files are reachable (or protections silently skipped) through approved-looking paths. Distinct from shell-based bypass (P-20260831-AE8A3EE7) and allowlist string-parsing mismatch (P-20260831-60EFB5BF): here the checker and executor disagree on filesystem path identity.
